verdict.rationale: No evidence item explicitly documents `stream=true` or SSE token streaming. Support is only implied: DeepInfra claims to be a drop-in OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API where existing OpenAI SDK code "works without changes", and it mentions time-to-first-token for priority requests, which suggests incremental output delivery. Missing for 10: explicit streaming/SSE documentation, stream parameter and chunk format details, and independent or hands-on confirmation that token-by-token streaming works.
